snippet.description:
Are you preparing for UPSC CSE 2028 and dreaming of becoming an IAS or IPS officer? Your UPSC journey starts with the right strategy, proper guidance and a disciplined study plan.

In this special session, we bring you the First 100 Days Survival Guide for UPSC 2028 Aspirants. If you are a beginner or starting your Civil Services preparation from zero, this session will help you understand how to approach the first 100 days effectively.

The initial phase of UPSC preparation is extremely important. Instead of studying randomly, aspirants need a structured roadmap that covers the basics, NCERTs, standard books, current affairs and answer-writing fundamentals.

- How to Start UPSC Preparation for 2028
- First 100 Days UPSC Study Plan
- Complete UPSC CSE Preparation Roadmap
- How to Read NCERT Books Effectively
- Subject-wise Preparation Strategy
- Important Books and Study Resources
- Newspaper Reading and Current Affairs Strategy
- UPSC Prelims and Mains Preparation Approach
- Daily Study Routine and Time Management
- Common Mistakes UPSC Beginners Must Avoid
- How to Stay Consistent During Preparation

- UPSC CSE 2028 Aspirants
- Beginners Starting UPSC Preparation
- First-Time Civil Services Aspirants
- IAS and IPS Aspirants
- Students Looking for a Structured UPSC Study Plan

Remember, UPSC success requires consistency, conceptual clarity, smart preparation and regular revision. Start your first 100 days with the right direction and build a strong foundation for your Civil Services journey.

Watch the complete session and begin your UPSC 2028 preparation with confidence!
